road.name: Mosquito Lake Road to Forest Road 38 (Middle Fork Nooksack)
road.driveNote: Roads cross private industrial timberland whose ownership has changed hands over the years (currently Hampton Family Forests, which requires a paid recreation permit); gate locations, mileage, and any permission requirements can change without notice — verify current status from recent trip reports before driving. Many parties bike the lower logging-road miles to save time.
road.seasonalGate: Gates and access vary with forestry activity and current ownership; check recent trip reports before a visit.
